title: Planks in Order

readiness.math: ordering by length (seriation), shortest to longest
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: I'm making steps for the chapel garden, and every step needs a plank a little longer than the last.

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Can you line them up for me, from the shortest to the longest?

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Put the planks in order, from the shortest to the longest.
steps.hint: Find the very shortest one first. Then find the next shortest.

feedback.out_of_order: Some planks are back on the table. Which is the shortest one left?
feedback.all_good: Shortest to longest, like a little staircase!

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: Look: they make a staircase. Each one just a little longer than the one before.

journal_line: I put Mr. Amos's planks in order, from the shortest to the longest.
unavailable_text: The planks are in order for today.
